[[ ]] The The decision marks a major setback setback for for the American American tech giant , which which has has been at the the center of an anti - monopoly monopoly investigation since 2018 2018 . The company had sought an an injunction to prevent the the CCI CCI from from enforcing enforcing its decision , which had been issued issued in in November November 2020 , that the company abused abused its market power by requiring handset handset makers makers to pre - install certain Google Google apps . [[ ]] In its its ruling , the the Competition Commission of of India found Google ’s Android operating operating system was used to to give its its search engine engine an unfair advantage advantage over its rivals . The The CCI further further argued that Google ’s ’s use of of its app app store as a monopoly to force device manufacturers to install Google apps stifled competition in the market market . Google had sought to block the ruling ruling , arguing that that the allegations allegations of of anti - competitive competitive behavior were were “ unfounded ” and and that it was not given given a fair hearing hearing before the CCI . The CCI , however , ruled against Google , noting that it had conducted a thorough investigation before ruling ruling against the tech giant . In response to the ruling , Google said in in a statement statement that that it it was disappointed with with the decision and that it “ will continue to defend our ability to freely develop and offer products products to users users and and to ensure that Android Android remains an an open platform . ” The company also said that that it it would review the decision and consider consider its options . The Competition Commission ’s ’s ruling ruling is a major victory for the anti - monopoly movement and could have far - reaching implications implications for other tech giants giants such as as Amazon Amazon , Apple , and Facebook . It also serves as a warning to to tech giants giants that they must abide abide by by antitrust laws or face face the consequences . [[ ]] The ruling comes comes at a time when there is an an increasing increasing focus on the power power of Big Big Tech , with both both the US and EU launching antitrust investigations into a number of of tech giants giants . Google is facing antitrust investigations in both the US and and Europe , with with the the US Department of Justice recently recently filing a lawsuit lawsuit against against the company . [[ ]] Google has also been hit with antitrust fines in the EU EU . In In July July 2018 , the European European Commission fined Google € 4.3 billion ( $ 5.1 billion ) for abusing its market market power with its Android operating system . The Commission Commission also ordered ordered Google Google to to stop requiring requiring device makers to pre - install Google Search and the Chrome browser browser on their devices . In response to the CCI CCI ruling , Ajit Mohan Mohan , the the CEO of of Google India , said the the company respects the decision of the commission and and that it was was “ committed to an open open , competitive , and vibrant app ecosystem ecosystem . ” He added that Google would continue to to work with partners to to ensure ensure that users in India had access to a range of products products and services . The CCI ruling is is a landmark decision that is likely likely to have far far - reaching implications for how how tech giants do business in in India . text: The huge omnibus spending spending bill bill that was unveiled Tuesday Tuesday contains an important series of provisions to help Americans save more more . Buried in the 4,100 page bill is the " Secure 2.0 " plan which would would , among other other things things , require employers to automatically enroll employees in their 401(k ) plan at a rate of least 3 % but not not more more than 10 10 % of their salary . Businesses with 10 or fewer employees or in business less than than three years years would be be excluded . Does n't sound like much much , but but it 's a potentially important important leap in helping overcome overcome the retirement crisis . You can thank thank a University of of Chicago professor professor , Richard Richard Thaler , for helping popularize the the idea idea . Thaler is one one of the founding founding fathers of behavioral economics economics , which studies how people really really behave behave , not not how they are supposed to behave . One of those insights is that humans tend not to take take action when they should : there there is a lot of of " inertia " in in human decisions . Thaler designed many " nudges " that helped spur people to to do things beneficial to them them . Like saving saving more money for retirement . Thaler 's 's ' nudge ' Employer Employer - sponsored 401(k ) plans have been around around since since the late late 1970s , but a lot of of workers do do n't sign up for them , even when employers employers offer matching contributions contributions . Not signing signing up made little little sense , except if if you you understood that humans humans often do n't act in in their own self - interest . Thaler Thaler 's 's " nudge , " which which he suggested some 20 years ago , was automatic automatic enrollment enrollment : employees employees are are automatically enrolled in the program , unless they opt out . Congress built built on that suggestion : the Pension Pension Protection Act of 2006 encouraged encouraged employers to adopt automatic enrollment plans . It caught on , and many many companies companies adopted the idea . Enrollment went way way up up . Today , about 6 in 10 employers offer automatic enrollment enrollment . A 2021 Vanguard study found that 91 % of new hires stay in in the plan when enrollment enrollment is is automatic , compared with 28 % at at firms where where contributions are are voluntary voluntary . They They also tend tend to increase increase contributions over time . The The Secure 2.0 bill bill further codifies that practice practice into law . Americans do n't save enough for retirement Remember the old " three legged legged stool stool " for retirement : personal savings , a pension and Social Security . That 's 's mostly gone . Few Few young Americans Americans have pensions . The average Social Security is check is is $ 1,400 a month , not enough enough to get by for most most people . That leaves leaves personal savings savings . We need more " nudges " to to get people to save more . The The Secure Secure 2.0 provisions would also create bigger " catch - up up " contributions contributions for older workers , allowing workers to to put put away away an extra $ 10,000 a year once they are over 50 ( the current limit is $ 6,500 6,500 ) . It would also also increase the age when when Required Minimum Distributions would start , first to 73 from the current current 72 72 , and then then 75 in 2033 . Thank Thank you , Richard Thaler Thaler Thaler won the the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Economic Sciences in 2017 for for his contributions contributions to understanding human behavior . He has spent a lifetime studying irrational behavior , but when he won the Nobel Nobel Prize Prize he joked that he intended to to spend the prize money money " as irrationally as as possible . " There 's 's a man who not only understands people , he he understands himself .
